outOfScopeCommentTemplate:
Hii Team,

Seller reimbursement team no longer handles any Fees reimbursement's process. We have already updated the same in our Seller Reimbursement Escalation wiki:
https://w.amazon.com/bin/view/IN_Reimbursement_Escalation

For ES:

Easy ship Fee related concerns and/or their Claw back related SAFE-T issues are out of Seller Reimbursement's scope. Please reach out to following CTI:

C: Easy Ship
T: Program Problem
I: Weight Mismatch
Group: Amazon Easy Ship Program

For FBA/Seller Flex Fees issues:

For escalations, please reach out to the T4 Credit Ops team by using the CTI:

C: Fulfillment By Amazon
T: Shipping Claims
I: Fees Escalations

Note: Tickets have to be assigned only to this Group: T4 Credit Ops Project IN.

categories.name: Removal Order Damaged
categories.sampleFormat:
Removal Order ID: [e.g. 260601191A]
Tracking ID (AWB): [carrier tracking]
FC ID: [fulfillment center id]
Case ID: [case id]
FNSKU / LPN of damaged item: [e.g. X002EKIG17]

Mandatory attachments:
- Unboxing Video (from receiving to opening each item)
- Product images (all 6 sides + damage close-up)

Optional:

categories.name: Removal - Missing Units / Switcheroo / Main Item Missing
categories.sampleFormat:
1. Issue type: [Missing Accessory / Main Unit Missing / Switcheroo / Short Shipment]
2. SPS Case ID: [case id]
3. Within claim window (Yes/No): Yes
4. Removal Order ID: [e.g. 260601191A]
5. FC ID: [fulfillment center id]
6. Tracking ID (AWB): [carrier tracking]
7. LPN and FNSKU: [e.g. X002EKIG17 - 1 unit missing]
8. Quantity: [total units missing]
9. Unboxing Video: Attached [or Google Drive link]

Optional:
- Copy of POD

categories.name: Missing From Inbound (MFI)
categories.sampleFormat:
Shipment ID: [e.g. FBA15LRHVTK2] (Max 10 per SIM for AMs/Sales, Max 1 for SP-SEED)
Merchant ID: [seller merchant id]
SPS Case ID: [case id]
FNSKU and claim Quantity:
  - [FNSKU 1] - [X units missing]
  - [FNSKU 2] - [X units missing]

Required documents:
- If Partnered Carrier: Tracking ID + STN / Delivery Challan
- If Non-Partnered: EPOD + STN with FC stamp (all pages, full-size)
- If shipment > INR 50,000: Invoice / Proof of Purchase

Pre-submission checks (Yes/No):
- Duplicate check: [Yes/No]
- Valid POD: [Yes/No]
- Cross match: [Yes/No]
- Packaging & Prep requirements followed per category

Note: Amazon Partnered Carrier auto-reimburses if not received within 14 business days from pickup date.
